R package · D3.js · SVG

Interactive D3 charts, one R function at a time

ddplot turns a data frame into an interactive SVG chart. More than 40 chart types, from everyday line and bar charts to chord diagrams and sunbursts, that work in the RStudio viewer, R Markdown, Quarto and Shiny. No JavaScript required.

Get started Browse the gallery
>install.packages("ddplot")
1

One function per chart

Pass a data frame and column names. Every chart shares the same vocabulary: title, xtitle, fill, bgcol, font…

2

Interactive by default

Tooltips, hover highlights, sorting and animations. line_chart() adds zoom, range buttons, a navigator and annotations.

3

Works where R works

RStudio viewer, R Markdown, Quarto, and Shiny through d3Output() and renderD3(). Save any chart as a standalone HTML file.

A first chart

A ts object, or a data frame with a date column and one or several value columns, is all line_chart() needs:

library(ddplot)

line_chart(
  EuStockMarkets,
  transform = "index",
  title = "European stock indices",
  subtitle = "Rebased to 100 at the first visible date"
)

Hover to read every series at a date, drag on the chart to zoom, click the legend to hide a series. The Get started guide goes further, and covers Shiny.

Installation

Install the released version from CRAN:

install.packages("ddplot")

Or the development version from GitHub:

remotes::install_github("feddelegrand7/ddplot")
